scope: Finite float64 development checks of softmax TV/barycenter/pruning decomposition and premise counterexamples; no model or performance evaluation.

implementation.procedure: Read card derivation and frozen script; check stable softmax, shapes, masks and decomposition.
implementation.acceptance: No mathematical premise or implementation mismatch.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check two-token closed form independently and subset normalization identity; inspect empty/nonfinite cases and overlap counterexample.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Closed forms agree within 1e-10; invalid logits rejected; overlap claim limited to fixture.

data_integrity.procedure: Hash all artifacts; inspect unique record IDs/counts and finite outputs; preserve raw failures if any.
data_integrity.acceptance: No duplicate/omitted cases; summary count agrees with all raw records.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Inspect values, units, tolerance, underflow and finite arithmetic; check large-logit and degenerate boundaries.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: All applicable checks pass; numerical fixtures not called proof.

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect elapsed-clock scope and claim; no speedup/model/token measurement.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Report seconds only as CPU verification duration; performance conclusions absent or N/A.

reproducibility.procedure: Independently execute frozen script into separate directory with same seed and compare all records.
reproducibility.acceptance: Deterministic numerical records match; timings may differ.
